description:
A catastrophic chain of tornadoes stretches across the United States in TWISTER ALLEY, the new disaster movie from The Asylum.

When a massive 1,000-mile tornado outbreak begins tearing through unprepared cities, a team of scientists races against time to stop the most destructive storm system ever recorded. As the disaster intensifies, massive fire tornadoes emerge, cities are threatened, and the East Coast faces the possibility of total devastation.

With only hours remaining before the storm reaches catastrophic levels, the team must attempt a desperate plan to disrupt the system before millions of lives are placed in danger.
